result.summary: The page is largely well-formed; the main visual problems are text/content clipping at the right edge of horizontal carousels and a partially rendered empty category chip. No critical breakages were found.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped mid-word at the screen edge with no ellipsis, making the name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the label width to the card and apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Picco…'), or wrap to a second line within the card bounds.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge and appears empty, giving a broken look to the chip row.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding/peek spacing so partially visible chips still show some label text, or add a fade/gradient edge to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The last card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is abruptly cropped at the screen edge without any visual affordance (fade or padding) indicating more content.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding or an edge fade so the cropped card reads as intentional carousel overflow rather than a rendering error.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom (with the −20% badge) shows only the image with no visible restaurant name or metadata before the tab bar, which can look incomplete if the list doesn't scroll further.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card's title and details are laid out directly below the image and confirm the section is scrollable; consider bottom padding so content isn't hidden behind the tab bar.
